title: Three-room Apartment Interior Design 47 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 47 m² three-room apartment: interior design. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Interior design project example: a 3-room (two-bedroom) apartment in just 47 m²

blocks.text: Interior design project example: a 3-room (two-bedroom) apartment in just 47 m²

parts.html: An interior design project for a 47 m² three-room apartment. The brief was not an easy one: fit a living room combined with the kitchen, a bathroom, a children’s room with a desk and the parents’ bedroom into this floor area. We did the layout and visualizations of every room. The interior is in a gray-beige palette with wood tones, and the rooms have chevron parquet floors.

The living room and kitchen were joined into one bright space. The bathroom was placed so it can be reached from every room. In the children’s room, the balcony was added to the living area, and built-in furniture and storage systems organize the space for sleeping, playing and studying. The compact parents’ bedroom was kept separate and closed off; zoning and a calm color give it privacy.

The doors from the living room to the other rooms are concealed: the wall is clad in dark oak-look panels, and the door leaves sit flush with them, so they are barely visible. Vertical light lines run along the corners of this wall, and linear fixtures are built into the ceiling.

The upper kitchen cabinets and the tall unit have fluted fronts in a gray-brown tone, the lower units are light and matte, and the sink sits by the window. The dining area is a round glass table on a black base with upholstered chairs in a light fabric, and above them hangs a chandelier with white globe shades and brass details. Next to it is a display cabinet with reeded glass in a black frame.

The children’s room has a bed with an olive upholstered headboard, a floor-to-ceiling wardrobe beside it and open shelves. On the added balcony, a desk with drawers runs along the window, and low cabinets for toys and books sit under the window. In the bedroom, one whole wall is taken up by a wardrobe with smooth, light, handleless fronts, and the bed has a soft headboard with vertical channel stitching.

The bathroom is finished in large light stone-look tile and fluted terracotta-colored tile. There is a vanity unit with a basin, an oval mirror with lighting and a shower behind glass in a black frame; the faucets and heated towel rail are black too.
